description: Horaires théoriques et du réseau de transports QUB (transports urbains de Quimper Bretagne Occidentale) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Quimper Bretagne Occidentale. This dataset offers the theoretical transport offer (lines, stops, schedules) and real time (times of next crossings and geolocation) of the QUB network. This data is produced by RDQBO, public transport public service delegate of Quimper Occidentale. The theoretical offer is available in GTFS format ( ). Coverage: Quimper Bretagne Occidentale. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical timetables and transport network QUB (urban transport of Quimper Western Brittany)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Quimper Bretagne Occidentale. Its keywords include gtfs, transport-en-commun, bus, transport, transport-public. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
